# Re-layout insurance: results (visits_20261003_123624_jev_s21-22_main)

*Generated by `python3 sim/visits.py report --run visits_20261003_123624_jev_s21-22_main` from `visits_20261003_123624_jev_s21-22_main.eval.json` and `visits_20261003_123624_jev_s21-22_main.json`. Every number below names the JSON path it comes from. Framing rule: **in simulation**, 8 synthetic shoppers per archetype (12 archetypes, seeds [21, 22]), under the labelled assumptions listed at the end. Nothing here is a measurement of real shoppers.*

## Read this first (honest headline)

**Run status.** The spec asked for 144 shoppers (12 archetypes x 4 x seeds 21, 22, 23). Partway through seed 23, TypeSafe returned HTTP 402 ("Your organization has no available TypeSafe API credits"). That turned 3,356 seed-23 slot decisions into errors. **Seed 23 is excluded completely.** Everything below uses **seeds 21 and 22: 96 shoppers, 576 agent-visits, 0 errors.** The failed full file is kept as evidence (`visits_20261003_123624_jev_s21-22-23_main.json`, `design.seed_23_excluded`). Every later Jev call also returns 402, so **the sensitivity sweep (p_search_moved 0.25/0.75/1.0, route_card_logit 0.5/1.0), stress tests (a) mixtures and (c) OCEAN jitter, and the `--detour 1` variant were not run.** Each needs new Jev calls.

1. **Primary metric, as pre-registered: no detectable lift.** Basket completion at visit 3, card minus control at c = 0.2, is **+0.002 [0.000, +0.004]**. The CI touches 0, so we do not claim a lift. Only 21 of 96 shoppers comply at c = 0.2 because of reactance (`ab.by_compliance.0.2`). At c = 0.5 the lift is +0.021 [+0.009, +0.035]; if every shopper followed the card it would be +0.031 [+0.018, +0.046].
2. **The lift is our routing assumption (fatal flaw 5, confirmed in code).** At visit 3, zero events differ on slots that both arms walked. All 33 habit items the card path gains sit on units the control path never walked (`ab.decomposition_v3`). With route_card_logit = 0, the card changes nothing Jev judges; it only changes which units are walked. So the size of the effect is set by `p_search_moved` = 0.5, an assumption, and could not be swept (no credits).
3. **The re-layout costs habit shoppers little in this store.** Seven of eight categories move, but they swap among units a weekly shopper already walks. At visit 3 the control path still finds 0.895 of habit categories (`v3.habit_cat_found`). The "reference" v1→v2 re-take of 0.371 is **not** a like-for-like baseline for the v3 completion of 0.273 (different denominators), so we do not quote a dip size.
4. **Guardrails.** Total basket £ does not fall; off-mission (impulse) £ at v3 is unchanged (+0.000). "Unplanned £ by route" falls at v3 (−£0.48 at c = 0.2), but this is partly a definition artefact: under the spec definition, habit items the control shopper found by search count as unplanned. Metres walked: no detectable change at c = 0.2.
5. **New challengers.** The trial-to-repeat difference is 0 at c = 0.2 (13 vs 13 shoppers) and +3 shoppers at c = 0.5/0.8, with a CI that touches 0. The new-SKU take rate does not move detectably at any c. This is no evidence that a supplier would pay for it.
6. **Persona ID is high and circular, so it is not a headline.** NB top-1 is 0.76 after 1 basket and 0.96 after 3. It beats the mission-only baseline by +0.42 to +0.47. But leave-one-out shoppers get a confident wrong label 88–100% of the time, and undeclared sensitive shoppers are confidently mislabelled 83–100% of the time.
7. **Safety finding (spec 5.1 d, reported because it is not 0):** if coeliac, vegan or GLP-1 shoppers do **not** declare, **16 of 43** cards that offered a new item failed the shopper's true hard gate. *Audit breakdown (traced from `card_undeclared` in the cards file):* all 16 are **vegan** shoppers offered Skyr creamy Natural (dairy; `swaps.gate_fail` "not labelled vegan"). Undeclared coeliac: 0 of 12 offers failed (no offered item lists gluten in OFF allergens). GLP-1: 15 offers, and `swaps.gate_fail` has **no GLP-1 gate**, so GLP-1 cannot fail this check by construction. Declared cards: 0 failures, but that is also by construction, because `routes.card` applies the same `gate_fail` to declared shoppers before offering. This is still the strongest argument in the run for "declared only, plus gate everything", but the evidence is one product (Skyr) and one rule (vegan).
8. **Next basket: "ours" does not beat the baselines.** Under the claim rule, no λ has a CI above both most-frequent and repeat-last at P@3 or P@5. λ = 0.75 is identical to most-frequent by construction. Caveat (verifier): the `most_frequent` and `repeat_last` rows break ties by the persona posterior, so they are not persona-free. The persona-free versions (`most_frequent_pure`, `repeat_last_pure`, ties by global popularity) score P@5 0.384 and 0.369. Against them ours (λ = 0.5) is still not claimable at P@3/P@5 (P@5 +0.005 [−0.008, +0.019] vs most_frequent_pure), but it **is** above both at P@10 (+0.025 [+0.013, +0.036] and +0.044 [+0.030, +0.058]). So: plain frequency for the top 5; the persona lens only earns its keep further down the list. The oracle (true-persona popularity, 0.356) is *below* most-frequent: personal history beats knowing the persona.
9. **Refusing health inference** costs 17–21 top-1 points of persona ID. For next-basket P@5 it costs **+0.006 [−0.004, +0.016]**, which is not detectable. Pitch line: "never guessing your diagnosis costs nothing measurable in prediction".

**Verifier fix:** the earlier assertion `control_equals_card_world_for_noncompliers` compared the control record with itself and could never fail. It is replaced by `v3_arms_share_history` (visit-3 memory and memory line identical across arms), which passes.

**Engine note found while building:** on the Jev path of `sim/run.py`, `basket` and `budget_left` are never updated (only the mock/llm branch does it). So Jev's state always says "basket so far: empty" and budget never binds. This is why the v3 arms are judgment-identical. It is existing behaviour, left untouched.

## Traceability audit (3 Oct 2026, after the run)

An adversarial audit traced 10 randomly sampled card lines (8 "moved", 2 "new") and 5 shoppers' persona posteriors back to OFF fields, Jev cache files, habit-log counts and config. All numbers traced: habit counts match the v1–v2 baskets, from/to slots match `data/store/planogram.json` and `planogram_retailer.json`, the `diff_ref`s point at the right `category_move`, route metres recompute with `routes.route`, lens scores match `catalog.json lens_grades`, P(take if seen) recomputes from `surrogate.json`, every one of the 4,507 basket picks has its Jev cache file on disk, and an independent Naive Bayes reproduces the persona posteriors and top-1 (0.7639 / 0.8889 / 0.9583 / 0.9583) exactly. The primary +0.0015 and the 33/33 decomposition also reproduce independently.

Four defects were found in the card **text and evidence**. They did not touch any simulated input. They were fixed in `sim/routes.py`, and all 192 cards were rebuilt from their stored inputs with `python3 sim/visits.py recard`, which refuses to write if a carded SKU, line, slot or route unit would change. None changed.
1. The OFF-field parser split free text on "=": 35 of 187 "new" lines showed a garbled field (`OFF pack 560g >=400g standard size`). Now only an exact `field=value (OFF…)` is parsed, and the full lens `why` list is carried in `evidence.lens.why`.
2. 48 of 48 declared-lens lines said "matches your picks". The lens was **declared**, not inferred from picks. They now say "fits what you told us".
3. 16 of 16 coeliac lines said "(gluten free)" for Skyr, which has no gluten-free label in OFF (`no_gluten_label=0`). That is a regulated claim the evidence does not support. The lens words are now "no gluten declared".
4. P(take) cited only the front-of-pack Jev cache key. The value blends front-of-pack and back-of-pack answers using `p_reads_labels`, and mixes personas by posterior. Every term is now listed in `evidence.p_take.components`, with both cache keys, and the label is now "P(take if seen)", because the value is conditional on looking.

Not fixed (reported): 30 of 187 offered new items have P(take if seen) < 0.05, so the card offers things the sim thinks the shopper will almost certainly ignore. Declared-lens cards still carry the inferred non-sensitive posterior in `posterior.distribution`, which is trace-only but is a label, not a lens. The mock dry-run cards were rebuilt the same way.

## Design

- Engine: **jev** (TypeSafe Jev via `sim/jev.py`; no OpenRouter/LLM calls). Shoppers: 96; agent-visits: 576 (v1-v2 shared, v3-v4 simulated twice: control path and card path = both potential outcomes).
- Layouts: v1-v2 `data/store/planogram.json` minus the new SKUs; v3-v4 `data/sim/layout/planogram_retailer.json` (the layout surface's revenue plan) with the new SKUs listed.
- New SKUs (`design.new_skus`, rule: challenger with the fewest facings in planogram_retailer.json; lowest barcode breaks ties):
  - biscuits_chocolate: `0061232201047` Stem Ginger Oat Biscuits (slot U2-r2, 4 challengers)
  - breakfast_cereal: `5060043225353` Lizi's Low Sugar Granola Nuts & Seeds (slot U1-r1, 4 challengers)
  - crisps_savoury: `5013665115373` Lentil & Pea Veggie Cakes Beetroot & Balsamic (slot U6-r2, 7 challengers)
  - plant_milk_dairy_alt: `5060120281975` Oat Organic Drink (slot U8-r1, 4 challengers)
  - ready_meals_soup: `5027040036603` Warming Carrot Soup (slot U5-r2, 5 challengers)
  - snack_bars: `5000159558396` Chocolate Chip cashew (slot U3-r2, 5 challengers)
  - soft_drinks: `5013665116417` Organic Cola (slot U4-r2, 6 challengers)
  - yoghurt: `4016241050199` Skyr creamy Natural (slot U7-r2, 5 challengers)
- Pre-registered primary (`design.preregistered_primary`): share of a shopper's habit items (taken in >= 1 of visits 1-2) taken again at visit 3; card world - control world, paired within shopper, at c=0.2, route_card_logit=0, p_search_moved=0.5.

### Where the lift comes from (`ab.decomposition_v3`)

- Events that differ between arms on slots both arms visited at v3: **0**.
- Habit items gained by the card path at v3: 33, of which on units the control path never walked: 33; habit items lost: 0.
- At visit 3 both arms share memory and every draw, and Jev's state does not depend on the route (basket_so_far stays empty on the jev path of run.py), so with route_card_logit=0 any v3 difference can only come from WHICH units are walked: the lift is the routing assumption (p_search_moved). Visit 4 also differs through memory (memory line + repaired route).

## Assumptions register (`design.assumptions`)

| name | value | source |
|---|---|---|
| p_search_moved | 0.5 | assumption; direction from research/03 Truth 2 'can't be bothered to look' (r/britishproblems 1uosc29, 507 pts). 1.0 is the decomposition reference (always finds a moved category) |
| compliance_c | 0.2 | assumption; there is no grounded card-follow rate. Headline at the conservative end |
| reactance_k | {"default": 1.0, "protein_sceptic_gimmick_reactant": 0.25, "habit_loyalist_shrinkflation_angry": 0.25, "frugal_unit_pric | assumption; Brehm 1966; White et al. 2008; research/03:57 |
| route_card_logit | 0.0 | assumption; nothing in sim/notice.py models 'told to look'. Spec asks for it in coefficients.json; kept here because this build may not edit coefficients.json |
| tau | 0.5 | assumption: abstain threshold on max posterior |
| lambda | 0.5 | assumption: next-basket mix weight |
| visit1_route | "units holding mission categories (as built)" | assumption: shoppers know the as-built store (research/03 Truth 2, memorised route) |
| habit_formation | "not modelled beyond the injected memory line" | Lally et al. 2010 (median ~66 days): one trial is not a habit; 'repeat' means v3 -> v4 only |
| browse_prob | 0.25 | sim/coefficients.json browse_prob (existing) |
| walk_speed_mps | 1.3 | sim/layout_optimise.PARAMS (existing) |
| compliance_draw | "hu(seed, agent, 'comply', 3) < c * reactance_k, drawn once at the first card (visit 3) and kept for visit 4" | deviation from spec 4.2 (which keys the draw by visit): a per-visit draw would need 4 visit-4 histories per shopper; the opt-in is modelled as a shopper-level decision so each shopper has exactly two potential paths (car |
| memory_line | "visits >= 2: third `habits` entry in the Jev shopper state, 'usually buys: <name> (n/v visits), ...' (top 4 by count)" | labelled injection, memory_injected_by: sim/visits.py; off with --no-memory-state |
| hfss_rule | "exclude hfss OR barred_from_restricted (in scope with uncertain data)" | sim/layout_optimise.hfss, conservative reading of 'never offers an HFSS product' |
| p_take_card | "P(pick_up|looked) * P(take|picked_up) from the surrogate, mixed by posterior" | data/sim/layout/surrogate.json (cached Jev Nouls, no new calls) |
